title: Pyne Pod 2in1 Mr Blue Prefilled Vape Pods - Pod Salt Edition
description: This Mr Blue Pod Pack for the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 Kit delivers a complex berry vape with a subtle cooling lift. Blueberries, Blackberries and Raspberries come together in a layered blend of dark and tangy sweetness, finished with a smooth touch of Ice for balance. It’s a well-known profile reimagined for the Pyne Pod format — rich, refreshing and unmistakably fruity. Each 2ml pod is filled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and designed for exclusive use with the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 device. The pods connect magnetically and allow you to rotate between flavours instantly using the twist-style mouthpiece. With two pods per pack, Mr Blue brings a bold and distinctive option to the Pyne Pod flavour range.
